name: ids-only-logging
summary: A JSON logger that lets only identifiers through: long strings withheld, secrets and emails masked, so no upstream text ever lands in a log line

spec.document: CrossRiver AI Platform on AgentCore, design specification 0.21 (2026-09-16)
spec.replacement_test: The same seeded-text test passes against the platform's telemetry sink; log lines carry ids only there too.
